role: XCTest suite for UserSettings defaults and Codable, TemperatureUnit conversions, SleepSchedule wake time and overnight window, FitnessLevel names, HRVSession windowUserAdjusted/sleepUserAdjusted round trip, SettingsManager's handling of an unreadable or held settings file, and the sealed settings file (round trip, plain files from older builds, a locked key at launch and at save). Declares LockedKeySeal, the lockable test seal BaselineTrackerTests and TrainingLoadConsistencyTests reuse.
types: LockedKeySeal: final class (Sendable, file scope) — a JSONFileSeal the test locks and unlocks; locked, sealing and opening sealed bytes throw EncryptionError.keychainError(-25308) while plain JSON passes through; unlocked, the app's key
state: UserSettingsTests.SettingsReader: Sendable test reader (OSAllocatedUnfairLock state: POSIX failure to throw, read count) injected into SettingsManager(settingsURL:read:)
savedPerformanceFlags: the host's perf.* UserDefaults mirrors, saved in setUp and put back in tearDown
LockedKeySeal.locked (OSAllocatedUnfairLock<Bool>, starts true); LockedKeySeal.lockedError (static: keychainError(-25308), errSecInteractionNotAllowed)
toplevel: Imports os (the reader's lock) and UIKit (the retry notification names).

units.does: The number of reads so far, under the lock.
Sets (or clears, with nil) the POSIX code later reads fail with, under the lock.
Under the lock counts the read and takes the failure code; with one throws readError(posix:), else returns the file's bytes.

Writes settings with maxHR 170 as plain JSON (as an older build did) to a temporary user_settings.json, builds SettingsManager(settingsURL:read:seal:) with a SettingsReader failing with EIO (setFailure(posix:)) and the app's seal, asserts the load outcome is .unreadableNotPreserved and returns the manager, reader and file.
Flushes the manager's pending write (asserting no error), then reads the settings file, opens it with the app's key and decodes it (SettingsManager.settingsDecoder).
Yields the main actor five times so tasks the manager scheduled (observer installation) run.
Held manager; the reader recovers; a body-weight change re-reads the file: outcome .loaded, maxHR 170 from the file and the change kept, in memory and on disk.
